title: Vision vs. Language SAE Sparsity: A Controlled Layerwise Characterization

original_idea.body: Use pre-trained Prisma vision SAEs and SAELens language SAEs to compare L0, firing-frequency, and dead-feature rates layer-by-layer; no training.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Cross-modal SAE tooling transfer matters for safety but indirect catastrophic-risk chain (level 3).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Pre-trained SAEs, no training, measure standard sparsity metrics; accessible (level 5).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped descriptive comparison with clear deliverable (level 5).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Open pre-trained weights, no lab infra, externally runnable (level 4).

novelty.reasoning: Sparsity discrepancy flagged open; layerwise characterization partly open; partially addressed.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Layerwise sparsity characterization may be partly open.
